title: M4 corrected-TRAIN detector candidate (Kaggle, Tesla T4): full 40-epoch retraining from COCO weights with the four corrected training boxes; not promoted

source.archive: PHASE2_KAGGLE_RERUN_20261105.zip, 895,191,165 bytes, SHA-256 a91ad0e38ad263d3a19ad7fe574a327c38be3681aa56c2634e29108d91037270 (10 parts, member hashes in PHASE2_KAGGLE_OUTPUT_MANIFEST.json)

recipe: YOLO11s from COCO weights, 640 px, batch 16, 40 epochs, seed 42, deterministic, optimizer=auto (AdamW); train split 5,123 with exactly four corrected TRAIN boxes (english_cocker_spaniel_142, beagle_189, german_shorthaired_148, japanese_chin_178); validation and test labels unchanged (M4_TRAINING_DELIVERY_AUDIT.json)

curve_metrics_conf0.001_nms0.70.verification_status: validation mAP50-95 (0.8387498 vs 0.8435842) confirmed in KAGGLE_CANDIDATE_WEIGHT_IDENTITY.json; the test rows are as reported by results/detector_corrected/COMPARISON.json in the archive and were not recomputed here

operating_point_conf0.40_nms0.50_iou0.50.verification_status: counts rescored locally from the per-image predictions by the workstream (M4_LOCAL_METRICS_AUDIT.json, all_passed true); the historical row equals report/evidence/M4_detection_test_metrics.json

onnx_candidate_check.verdict: candidate passes the four-random-input check and fails the 50-real-image check under the same bound; served historical detector keeps its A9b failure; A9b bound unchanged; source results/candidate_verification/candidate_ONNX.json and results/verification/ONNX_PARITY.json (as reported, not recomputed here)

external_coco_count_diagnostic.cohort: 349 published COCO cat/dog images frozen before inference; 175-image test portion incl. 26 multi-animal
external_coco_count_diagnostic.note: not independent of COCO-pretrained YOLO development; thresholds not selected on it; as reported in results/candidate_verification/external_pipeline_summary.json

t4_service_regression.conditions: one T4, batch 1, two PyTorch threads, first 50 validation IDs cycled, 10 warm-up + 200 timed calls, images off; different cohort from the acceptance benchmark, not combined with it

decision: The historical detector (SHA-256 f48e4d8e...) stays the served default: the candidate's validation mAP50-95 is lower and selection on test is not allowed. The candidate is kept as a measured experiment; corrected labels alone do not demonstrate a quality gain.
scope: Training on the corrected labels was done by the segmentation workstream on Kaggle; it is not a retraining of the project detector and does not change any served threshold, weight or acceptance criterion.
